name: diagram
description: Deterministic technical diagrams: turn a Mermaid source into a tracked SVG/PNG/PDF asset, locally and free. Renders via the Mermaid CLI (mmdc, fetched on first run via npx at a pinned version) in a system headless Chrome. Detects the browser (google-chrome / chromium / ...) and offers a consent-gated assisted install; degrades to structural validation (source kept) when no browser is present. Not organic/photo imagery, not motion, not custom design craft.

chrome.manual: Install a Chromium-based browser so mmdc can render headlessly — Debian `sudo apt install chromium`; Ubuntu ships it as a snap (`sudo snap install chromium`); Fedora `sudo dnf install chromium`; Arch `sudo pacman -S chromium`; macOS `brew install --cask google-chrome`. Any of google-chrome / google-chrome-stable / chromium / chromium-browser on a system PATH works.
